programme.title: BOKS: Joshua KakiSi - and Azeez / Boks: Joshua Buatsi - Dan Azeez
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. programme.title: Football - Scotland League: Dundee - Dundee United / Fudbal - Škotska liga: Dundee - Dundee United
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship in its first season has set out in 1890. years and has already been set up by one rarity. Two teams then divided the champion title because of the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today the world-famous Glazegov Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles and today a relatively unknown club Dumbarton. The League itself has changed the names and format in a couple of occasions, but since 2013. it is officially called Scottish Professional Football League and is the highest rank of Scottish football. League also marks one of the largest derbies in the history of football between the two Glasgovske teams of Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. Dve ekipe su tada podelile šampionsku titulu zbog istog broja bodova na kraju sezone. To su bili danas svetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata menjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove Scottish Professional Football League i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obeležava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

programme.title: Football - English League: Leeds - Everton / Fudbal - Engleska liga: Leeds - Everton
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Duke - Joker / Košarka - KLS: Vojvodina - Joker
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: FMP - Zlatibor, G2 / Košarka - KLS: FMP - Zlatibor, G2
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Fundbal - League of Europe: Review / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Pregled
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Hockey - KHL: Lokomotiv - tractor / Hokej - KHL: Lokomotiv - Traktor
programme.desc: The strongest hockey hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called KHL or a continental hockey league. Only the competition was created from the Russian Super League in 2008. At the end of the season, the winner of the KHL Plejofa received a prestigious Gagarin Cup, while the best placed the Russian team wins the title of Russia Champions. Since 2011. programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: CSKA - locomotive / Košarka - VTB liga: CSKA - Lokomotiv
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine were also involved. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Severne Evrope. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Spartak - Crvena Zvezda / Košarka - ABA liga: Spartak - Crvena Zvezda
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Borac - Široki Brijeg / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Borac - Široki Brijeg
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

A zatímco Avitabile zůstává ve vězení další rok, Genny musí vládnout nad severní Neapolí a Římem. Ciro se sice pomstí, ale jeho sny a rodina jsou zničeny.

programme.desc: A brand new series of "container war" proves that a good balance in the bank account does not yet guarantee success in the world of port auctions, in which everything is happening at a flash pace. Hughes and Matthew Gaus. Who will be out of the "container wars" as a winner? / Povsem nova serija "Kontejnerske vojne" dokazuje, da dobro stanje na bančnem računu še ne zagotavlja uspeha v svetu pristaniških dražb, v katerem se vse dogaja z bliskovitim tempom. V tej igri visokih vložkov sta za premagovanje nasprotnikov, ki si prav tako želijo obogateti, potrebna tudi dober nos za blago in jekleni živci. Ker gre za velike vsote denarja, to ni nikakršna igra, pač pa prava vojna. Spoznajte dražbarja Johna Kunkla in udeležence dražb, ki se med seboj borijo za najboljše kupčije, med katerimi sta tudi Jason R. Hughes in Matthew Gaus. programme.title: Football: Bundesliga for Women: Prediction: 1. Round / Nogomet: Bundesliga za ženske: Napoved: 1. krog
Football (Ž): Carl Zeiss Jena - Hoffenheim, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (Ž): Carl Zeiss Jena - Hoffenheim, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: Women's Bundesliga is starting a new season in which fans can rejoice in top football and tense duels. The defender of the title FC Bayern, VFL Wolfsburg and Eintracht Frankfurt are also considered to be the main favorites this season in the fight for the title. At the other end of the scale, newcomers and candidates will from the beginning strive to collect important points in order to secure the league. Sport1 will accompany the season with detailed forecasts, interviews and analyzes - live and up close. The Federal League is the highest level of competition in women's football in Germany. It was founded in 1990 by the German Football Federation, according to the Men's Federal League model. It competes with twelve teams, and the seasons last from late summer to spring next year, with a break in winter. / Ženska Bundesliga začenja novo sezono, v kateri se lahko navijači ponovno veselijo vrhunskega nogometa in napetih dvobojev. Branilec naslova FC Bayern, VfL Wolfsburg in Eintracht Frankfurt tudi v tej sezoni veljajo za glavne favorite v boju za naslov prvaka. Na drugem koncu lestvice si bodo novinci in kandidati za izpad že od začetka prizadevali zbrati pomembne točke, da bi si zagotovili obstanek v ligi. SPORT1 bo sezono spremljal s podrobnimi napovedmi, intervjuji in analizami – v živo in od blizu.Ženska zvezna liga je najvišji nivo tekmovanja v ženskem nogometu v Nemčiji. Leta 1990 jo je ustanovila Nemška nogometna zveza, po modelu moške zvezne lige. V njej tekmuje dvanajst ekip, sezone pa trajajo od poznega poletja do pomladi naslednje leto, s premorom pozimi.

programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, starting matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Slovenia - Sweden, World Cup qualifiers 2026 / Nogomet (M): Slovenija - Švedska, Kvalifikacije za Svetovno prvenstvo 2026
programme.desc: Slovenia starts its journey to the 2026 World Cup in Stožice against Sweden. programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Slovenia - Sweden, World Cup qualifiers 2026 / Nogomet (M): Slovenija - Švedska, Kvalifikacije za Svetovno prvenstvo 2026
programme.desc: Slovenia starts its journey to the 2026 World Cup in Stožice against Sweden. More than two hundred members of the International Football Organization (FIFA), competing in the qualifiers for the main World Cup tournament. However, it is common for everyone to be an overture to the final tournament. The qualification is still increasing the fact that no one but the host has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions have to compete for the opportunity to defend the title. / Slovenija svojo pot do svetovnega nogometnega prvenstva 2026 začenja v Stožicah proti Švedski.Več kot dvesto članic Mednarodne nogometne organizacije (FIFA) tekmuje v kvalifikacijah za glavni turnir svetovnega prvenstva v nogometu.Dolge in zelo napete kvalifikacije se razlikujejo glede na to, za katero kontinentalno konfederacijo gre. Vsem pa je skupno to, da gre za uverturo v končni turnir.Pomen kvalifikacij še povečuje dejstvo, da na zaključnem turnirju nima pravice sodelovati nihče razen gostitelja, svetovni prvaki pa se morajo izboriti za priložnost za obrambo naslova.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Imago Sloveniae Festival 2013: Vocal Academy Ljubljana, conductor Stojan Kuret, recording from the Šentjakob Church in Ljubljana, Mon. / Festival Imago Sloveniae 2013: Vokalna akademija Ljubljana, dirigent Stojan Kuret, posnetek iz Šentjakobske cerkve v Ljubljani, pon.
programme.desc: R: Šuligoj Jaka ... Vocal Academy Ljubljana was founded in September 2008 and consists of sixteen to twenty experienced choir singers from all over Slovenia. In 2009, at the 57th International Choir Competition in Arezzo, Italy, she convincingly won in all four registered categories and won the grand prize. The latter led the Vocal Academy of Ljubljana as the first male choir in history on May 15, 2010, to win the competition for the Grand Prix of Europe. In 2011, they also received the prestigious Guidoneum Award 2011 in Arezzo for outstanding achievements and contribution to the development of choir music on a global scale. The persistent and dedicated artistic director and conductor of the singers group is Maestro Stojan Kuret. Under his leadership, home audiences presented themselves in the filled church of St. Jacob in Ljubljana. They invited guest musician, pianist Mojca Prus and soprano Martina Burger to their performance. / R: Šuligoj Jaka... Vokalna akademija Ljubljana je bila ustanovljena septembra 2008 in jo sestavlja od šestnajst do dvajset izkušenih zborovskih pevcev iz vse Slovenije. Leta 2009 je na 57. mednarodnem zborovskem tekmovanju v Arezzu v Italiji prepričljivo zmagala v vseh štirih prijavljenih kategorijah ter osvojila še veliko nagrado. Slednja je Vokalno akademijo Ljubljana kot prvi moški zbor v zgodovini 15. maja 2010 v Varni popeljala še do zmage na Tekmovanju za veliko nagrado Evrope. Leta 2011 so v Arezzu prejeli še prestižno nagrado Guidoneum award 2011 za izjemne dosežke in doprinos k razvoju zborovske glasbe v svetovnem merilu. Vztrajni in predani umetniški vodja in dirigent skupine pevcev je maestro Stojan Kuret. Pod njegovim vodstvom so se domači publiki predstavili v napolnjeni Cerkvi sv. Jakoba v Ljubljani. Na svoj nastop so povabili gostujoči glasbenici, pianistko Mojco Prus in sopranistko Martino Burger.

programme.desc: Part 1: The Eiffel Tower, the engineering challenge, presentes the history of the famous Eiffel Tower, the symbol of Paris and France. It was built as a central attraction of the World Exhibition, which was held in Paris in 1889 to commemorate the centenary of the French Revolution. Stunning recordings and comments from experts reveal how, at that time, the fully incomprehensible idea of ​​building a more than 300 -meter -high iron tower, despite numerous criticisms and relentless attacks of powerful opponents, has recently grown a masterpiece, who has always written the name of Gustav Eiff. / Leurope des Mervilles II. / France / 2024 / Director: Jean-Edouard Choppin. / 1. del: Eifflov stolp, inženirski izzivPrvi del predstavi zgodovino znamenitega Eifflovega stolpa, simbola Pariza in Francije. Zgrajen je bil kot osrednja zanimivost svetovne razstave, ki so jo leta 1889 v počastitev stoletnice francoske revolucije priredili v Parizu. Osupljivi posnetki in komentarji strokovnjakov razkrivajo, kako je iz drzne, za tisti čas popolnoma nepojmljive zamisli o gradnji več kot 300 metrov visokega železnega stolpa kljub številnim ostrim kritikam in neusmiljenim napadom močnih nasprotnikov nazadnje zrasla mojstrovina, ki je ime inženirja Gustava Eiffla za vedno zapisala v zgodovino.THE WONDERS OF EUROPE II. / LEUROPE DES MERVEILLES II. / Francija / 2024 / Režija: Jean-Edouard Choppin.

programme.title: What is it, a girl or a crazy serious about MUCK, entertainment documentary, Mon. / Kaj ti je, deklica ali Blazno resno o Desi Muck, razvedrilna dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.desc: "When she was little, she knew something would be out of her," recalls the father of our top writer, the extraordinary actress and the versatile creator of Des Muck. "Her life is for at least one movie," says her friend Darja Švajger, who, in addition to all three daughters, Lila Prap, Alan Hranitel, Maria Galunič, Jure Ivanusic, Tilna Artača, Vlad Kreslin and many others talked about this truly unique personality. Desa won the Ježek Award in 2016, which was the reason for making a documentary full of fun anecdotes, although on the other hand reveals that Desa Muck is by no means entertaining and nagging, as she remains in the memory of the Zoom show, but is a delicate and brave woman who is not afraid of anything who is wrong, A shy lady who is hard to get home. / “Že ko je bila majhna, je vedela, da nekaj iz nje bo,” se spominja oče naše vrhunske pisateljice, izjemne igralke in vsestranske ustvarjalke Dese Muck. “Njeno življenje je za vsaj en film,” pravi njena prijateljica Darja Švajger, ki je poleg vseh treh hčerk, Lile Prap, Alana Hranitelja, Maria Galuniča, Jureta Ivanušiča, Tilna Artača, Vlada Kreslina in mnogih drugih spregovorila o tej zares unikatni osebnosti. Desa je leta 2016 dobila Ježkovo nagrado, kar je bil povod za snemanje dokumentarnega filma, ki je poln zabavnih anekdot, čeprav po drugi strani razkriva, da Desa Muck nikakor ni samo zabavna in nagajiva, kot je ostala v spominu gledalcev oddaje ZOOM, pač pa je občutljiva in hrabra ženska, ki se ne ustraši ničesar, ki rešuje krivice sveta in neštete težave ljudi v stiskah, hkrati pa je sramežljiva gospa, ki jo težko spraviš od doma.

programme.title: Mouse who roared, British-American film, Mon. / Miš, ki je rjovela, britansko-ameriški film, pon.
programme.sub-title: The mouse that roared; On the 100th anniversary of Peter Sellers's birth / The Mouse That Roared; Ob 100. obletnici rojstva Petra Sellersa
programme.desc: The fictional pocket alpine country Grand Fenwick finds herself on the verge of decaying when the American company takes her monopoly over her only export product, wine. The government is trying to plan: to predict the US war, and then immediately surrender and enjoy the generous American help. A small army in medieval armor lands in almost empty New York and accidentally receives a destructive nuclear bomb and its inventor under control. Instead of defeat, he finds himself in a situation where he can blackmail the world superpowers. During the diplomatic chaos, romance also emerges between the unaccepted commander and the scientist's daughter. A movie with insightful humor converts the logic of the Cold War and the policy of the superpower.8. In September, we celebrate the 100th anniversary of Peter Sellers (1925-1980), one of the most versatile and humorous British players. The master of transformation and the Akcente was famous with unforgettable roles in the series Pink Panther, in Satira Dr. Strangelov and in an unforgettable drama welcome, Mr. Chance. His ability to play several completely different characters in one movie is brilliantly illustrated by a comedy, which we play on Television Slovenia in the master's actor. Although it is a smaller movie in Sellers' career, we cannot avoid his hyper -pointing comedic game, as well as the humorous absurd scenario, such as today's comedies to miss ... Original title: The Mouse That Roard / British Film, 1959 / Director: Jack Arnold / Screenplay: Roger Macdougall, Stanley Mann, after Leonard Wibberley's novel / Starring: Peter Sellers, Jean Seberg, William Hartnell, David Kossooff, Leo Mckern. / Izmišljena žepna alpska državica Grand Fenwick se znajde na robu propada, ko ji ameriško podjetje spelje monopol nad njenim edinim izvoznim izdelkom, vinom. Vlada skuje načrt: napovedati vojno ZDA, nato pa se takoj predati in uživati v radodarni ameriški pomoči. Majhna vojska v srednjeveških oklepih pristane v skoraj praznem New Yorku ter po naključju dobi pod nadzor uničevalno jedrsko bombo in njenega izumitelja. Namesto poraza se znajde v položaju, ko lahko izsiljuje svetovne velesile. Med diplomatskim kaosom se poraja tudi romanca med nespretnim poveljnikom in znanstvenikovo hčerjo. Film s pronicljivim humorjem spreobrača logiko hladne vojne in politike velesil.8. septembra obeležujemo 100. obletnico rojstva Petra Sellersa (1925–1980), enega najbolj vsestranskih in duhovitih britanskih igralcev. Mojster preobrazb in akcentov je zaslovel z nepozabnimi vlogami v seriji Rožnati panter, v satiri Dr. Strangelove ter v nepozabni drami Dobrodošli, gospod Chance. Njegova sposobnost, da v enem filmu odigra več popolnoma različnih likov, sijajno ponazarja komedija, ki jo v priklon mojstrskemu igralcu predvajamo na Televiziji Slovenija. Čeravno gre za manjši film v Sellersovi karieri, se v njem ne moremo izogniti njegovi hiperprecizni komični igri, kot tudi ne duhovito absurdnemu scenariju, kakršne gre v današnjih komedijah nadvse pogrešati...Izvirni naslov: THE MOUSE THAT ROARED / Britanski film, 1959 / Režija: Jack Arnold / Scenarij: Roger MacDougall, Stanley Mann, po romanu Leonarda Wibberleyja / Igrajo: Peter Sellers, Jean Seberg, William Hartnell, David Kossoff, Leo McKern.

programme.title: Sons Burja - The story of the return of the Karst Shepherd to the border between man and wolf, documentary film, Mon. / Sinovi burje – Zgodba o vrnitvi kraškega ovčarja na mejo med človeka in volka, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Celar Miha ... This is the story of two sons of the storm, the Karst Shepherd Karst, a shepherd's dog and a Slovenian wolf, a famous Slavac, the originator of the wolf trope. / R: Čelar Miha... To je zgodba o dveh sinovih burje, kraškem ovčarju Krasu, pastirskem psu in slovenskem volku, znamenitem Slavcu, začetniku volčjega tropa.
programme.desc: Almost 300,000 dogs live in Slovenia, of which only 900 of the Karst Shepherds. The Karst Shepherd or Kraševec is the last Slovenian indigenous breed. The film is accompanied by the Karst from the rumble and the shepherd's small school in the Pižmohtova kennel in the Cerkljansko Hills to the Kržič farm above Podpečje, where at one year he becomes a shepherd's dog and gets its herd. The film, however, tells of another son of the storm - a Slovenian wolf. The parallel story presents the famous Slavac, who in 2012 embarked on a 1000 -kilometer route to Verona in Italy, where after 130 years, the wolf trope was formed again. In the film Karst, according to the ancient shepherd's method, he first raises Emil Pizmoht, says the whisperer to the dogs, and is taken over by the young and talented Jožef Kržič on the farm Kržič, who brings him to the end of the shepherd's Ur. Biologist dr. Miha Krofel, who is considered one of the greatest Slovenian and European connoisseurs of great beasts. There are only about 100 wolves living in Slovenian forests today. The film Sons of the Borje was produced by Astral film in co -production with RTVSLO and with the support of the SFC. The screenwriter and director was Miha Čelar, a coinist Blaž Vehovar, and the director of the photo was Rožle Breg. / V Sloveniji živi skoraj 300.000 psov, od tega le še 900 kraških ovčarjev. Kraški ovčar ali kraševec je zadnja slovenska avtohtona pasma. Film spremlja Krasa od skotitve in pastirske male šole v psarni Pižmohtova v Cerkljanskem hribovju do kmetije Kržič nad Podpečjo, kjer pri enem letu postane pastirski pes in dobi svojo čredo. Film pa pripoveduje o še enem sinu burje – slovenskem volku. Vzporedna zgodba predstavi znamenitega Slavca, ki se je leta 2012 podal na 1000 kilometrov dolgo pot do Verone v Italiji, kjer se je po 130 letih spet oblikoval volčji trop. V filmu Krasa po starodavni pastirski metodi najprej vzgaja Emil Pižmoht, pravi šepetalec psom, na kmetiji Kržič pa ga prevzame mladi in nadarjeni Jožef Kržič, ki ga z očetom pripelje do konca pastirskega uka. V svet volka in po Slavčevi sledi vse do Verone gledalce popelje biolog dr. Miha Krofel, ki velja za enega največjih slovenskih in evropskih poznavalcev velikih zveri. V slovenskih gozdovih danes živi le še okrog 100 volkov.Dokumentarni film Sinovi burje je nastal v produkciji Astral film v koprodukciji z RTVSLO in s podporo SFC. Scenarist in režiser je bil Miha Čelar, koscenarist Blaž Vehovar, direktor fotografije pa Rožle Breg.

programme.title: S-Prehodi: Dora Levpušček, President of the Society of Exiles of the Northern Primorska, Mon. / S-prehodi: Dora Levpušček, predsednica Društva izgnancev severne Primorske, pon.
programme.desc: In this show, we will pay homage to the 80th anniversary of the return of North Primorska and abroad to their homes. They expelled every tenth Slovene who lived in the German occupation area then, which is the highest percentage of exiles in all occupied European countries. The purpose of the occupiers was to eliminate the Slovenian nation as an ethnic unit. Slovenian exiles were displaced from Poland to France, from Macedonia to northern Germany. They suffered a versatile shortage, and when they arrived home, many found nothing. In German provinces alone, Slovenian exiles were installed in more than two hundred camps, mostly in Spodnja Samsa, Saxony and Wurttëmber. We invited the president of the Northern Primorska Dora Levpušček District Association to the guests. / V tokratni oddaji se bomo poklonili 80-letnici vrnitve severnoprimorskih in zamejskih izgnancev na njihove domove. Izgnali so vsakega desetega Slovenca, ki je živel tedaj na nemškem zasedbenem območju, kar je najvišji odstotek izgnancev v vseh zasedenih evropskih deželah. Namen okupatorjev je bil izničiti slovenski narod kot etnično enoto. Slovenski izgnanci so bili razseljeni od Poljske do Francije, od Makedonije do Severne Nemčije. Trpeli so vsestransko pomanjkanje, ob prihodu domov pa mnogi niso našli ničesar. Samo v nemških pokrajinah so slovenske izgnance namestili v več kot dvesto taboriščih, največ v Spodnji Sleziji, Saški in na Wurttëmberskem. V goste smo povabili predsednica Društva izgnancev severne Primorske Dora Levpušček.

Commercial room aquariums are also nice, but with 10 liter pools Wayde King and his partner Brett Raymer have little on the hat. From the octagonal eco system with murans and stingrays over the telephone booth aquarium to the shark tank for the doctor's practice: there is almost no idea that the boys do not dare to do. And their super aquariums not only like the underwater residents very well, but also to the audience. programme.title: Mountain Life - dream house wanted / Mountain Life - Traumhaus gesucht
programme.desc: After moving from a state in the United States, an outdoor-loving couple decides to settle in a ski resort in the Rocky Mountains. The town of Whitefish in Montana was once founded by fur handlers and has more than doubled its population - since the winter sports area was opened. It offers spectacular views of the Glacier National Park and over 100 slopes of all levels of difficulty. Here her little son can grow up in the middle of the unfortunate mountains and clean air. Now the couple is looking for a house with an open floor plan, a lot of cake and a large garden that fits into the budget. From the forested mountain dice of the Blue Ridge Mountains in the east of the Appalachen Uber soon Mountain with its grandiose alpine sports, the Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah and the picturesque peaks of the Rockies to Hawaiis Tropical Mauna Loa: There are numerous remote mountain varieties in the United States that hardly anyone knows. They are the perfect jerking point for stressed city and swinged families who escape from traffic chaos, hustle and bustle and pollution. And as different as the mountain destinations are, the real estate are so different, because, dependent on budgets and giftability, there are almost everything-from the rustic log hat with wood stove to the bamboo-bungalow with a volcanic view to a full-glazed design object with a private spa. The documentary series accompanies mountain fans in their search for the dream house. / Nachdem sie in den USA von einem Bundesstaat zum nachsten gezogen sind, beschliesst ein outdoor-begeistertes Ehepaar, sich in einem Skiresort in den Rocky Mountains niederzulassen. Das Stadtchen Whitefish in Montana wurde einst von Pelzhandlern gegrundet und hat seine Einwohnerzahl - seit Erschliessung des Wintersportgebiets - mehr als verdoppelt. Es bietet spektakulare Ausblicke auf den Glacier Nationalpark und uber 100 Pisten aller Schwierigkeitsgrade. Hier kann ihr kleiner Sohn inmitten unberuhrter Bergwelt und sauberer Luft aufwachsen. Nun sucht das Paar nach einem Haus mit offenem Grundriss, geraumiger Kuche und grossem Garten, das ins Budget passt.Von den bewaldeten Bergkuppen der Blue Ridge Mountains im Osten der Appalachen uber Bald Mountain mit seinen grandiosen Alpinsportmoglichkeiten, das Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah und die malerischen Gipfel der Rockies bis zu Hawaiis tropischem Mauna Loa: In den Vereinigten Staaten gibt es zahlreiche abgelegene Gebirgsorte, die kaum jemand kennt. Sie sind der perfekte Ruckzugsort fur gestresste Stadter und erschopfte Familien, die vor Verkehrschaos, Hektik und Umweltverschmutzung fluchten. Und so unterschiedlich die Mountain-Destinationen sind, so verschieden sind auch die Immobilien, denn, abhangig von Budgets und Verfugbarkeit gibt es fast alles - von der rustikalen Blockhutte mit Holzofen uber den Bambus-Bungalow mit Vulkanblick bis hin zum vollverglasten Designobjekt mit privatem Spa. Die Doku-Serie begleitet Berg-Fans bei ihrer Suche nach dem Traumhaus.

programme.title: The NATO - old friends, new fronts / Die Nato - Alte Freunde, neue Fronten
programme.desc: The documentary looks like the 75th anniversary of the NATO basis for the past, present and the future of NATO. Among other things, it illuminates that Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty is anything but binding, the necessary unanimity among the memberships is anything but safe and the necessary speed when loading troops and supplies in extreme cases is anything but secured. From where, in extreme cases, the relocation and supply is organized with supplies to the NATO headquarters in Brussel, where all political decisions are made. High-ranking reigning and former generals and security experts within NATO come up. Bundnis partner among themselves - not least for fear of a new strengthening Germany. And what were the consequences? And was there a promise after the collapse of the Soviet Union not to expand NATO to the east? And how is the relationship between Russia to NATO? / Der Dokumentarfilm blickt anlasslich des 75. Jahrestages der Nato-Grundung auf Vergangenheit, Gegenwart und Zukunft der Nato. Sie beleuchtet unter anderem, dass Artikel 5 des Nordatlantikvertrags alles andere als bindend, die erforderliche Einstimmigkeit unter den Mitgliedslandern alles andere als sicher und die erforderliche Schnelligkeit bei der Verladung von Truppen und Nachschub im Extremfall alles andere als gesichert ist.Dabei begibt sich der Film auf eine Reise quer durch das Bundnisgebiet, vom estlandischen Tallinn, dem Standort des Cyber-Defence-Zentrums der Nato, uber Ulm, von wo aus im Extremfall die Truppenverlegung und die Versorgung mit Nachschub organisiert wird, bis zum Nato-Hauptquartier in Brussel, wo alle politischen Entscheidungen getroffen werden. Hochrangige amtierende und ehemalige Generale und Sicherheitsexperten innerhalb der Nato kommen zu Wort.Daruber hinaus blickt die Dokumentation mithilfe von internationalen Historikern zuruck auf die 75-jahrige Geschichte der Nato: Gegrundet nach den verheerenden Erfahrungen des Zweiten Weltkriegs, ging es den Architekten des Bundnisses nicht nur um Abschreckung gegenuber Feinden von aussen, sondern vor allem auch um die Sicherung des Friedens der Bundnispartner untereinander - nicht zuletzt aus Angst vor einem erneuten Erstarken Deutschlands.Wichtige Zeitzeugen wie Donald Trumps ehemaliger Sicherheitsberater John Bolton und Top-Diplomat Wolfgang Ischinger ordnen pragende Ereignisse in der jungeren Geschichte der Nato ein: Wie kurz war die USA 2018 tatsachlich davor, die Nato zu verlassen? Und was waren die Folgen gewesen? Und gab es nach dem Zerfall der Sowjetunion ein Versprechen, die Nato nicht nach Osten zu erweitern? Und wie ist das Verhaltnis von Russland zur Nato?

Junge Menschen suchen nicht mehr im Internet, sie sprechen mit ihrem Chatbot uber Schulinhalte, aber auch uber Privates. Das Berufs- und Privatleben scheint sich derzeit grundlegend zu verandern. Aber wollen wir das? Wie stark soll KI unser Leben bestimmen? Und droht wirklich eine Massenarbeitslosigkeit?Daruber spricht Yves Bossart mit dem Berliner Philosophen und KI-Experten Christian Uhle.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: The sixth invitation will take the country women to Attelwil in Aargau. Christa and Michel Strub live here with their three children. You hold an entire zoo on your farm. For this purpose, chicken, ganse, ducks, turkey, cattle, wool pigs, sheep, goats and rabbits pay. They should be doing well everyone until they are processed into meat and sold on the weekly market in Aarau. Wurst, dry meat and eggs also belong to the offer. Michel works part -time as a metal building man. He grief about the rearing and maintenance of the animals, Christa for the sale of the meat. "It always works somehow," is the motto of the two, who obviously do not shy away from an effort. For the country women's dinner, they completely fuel your living and children's play room and set it up as a new gasteraum.christa, you would like to prepare everything fresh with your menu, and only for the minute. With a foamed courtyard soup and crostini, covered with bacon from the wool pig, it starts to be relaxed. With the duck breasts and homemade tagliatelle to the main course, however, almost the seconds. Also the dessert with a tree nut parfait, a warm raspberry coulis and a chocolate mesh no breather. There is a lot of hectic and great tension in the kitchen. It is only to be hoped that the country women will not trace. After all, they should enjoy. In any case, Michel, who serves, does not show anything. Seven country women cook for culinary specialists from their region. "SRF Bi de Lut - Landfrauenkuche" not only shows the farmers when cooking, but also accompanies them for a week through their everyday life and documents the preparations for the big country women's night. The focus is on the reference to the regional specialists and their preparation in the kitchen. The country women compete for the cooking competition seven times and judge each other. On a point scale from 1 to 10, the taste and the prase station of each course are rated. The winner will be chosen in the live finals on Saturday, November 5, 2016. / Die sechste Einladung fuhrt die Landfrauen nach Attelwil im Aargau. Hier leben Christa und Michel Strub mit ihren drei Kindern. Auf ihrem Hof halten sie einen ganzen Zoo. Dazu zahlen Huhner, Ganse, Enten, Truthuhner, Rinder, Wollschweine, Schafe, Ziegen und Kaninchen. Ihnen soll es allen moglichst gut gehen, bis sie zu Fleisch verarbeitet und auf dem wochentlichen Markt in Aarau verkauft werden. Zum Angebot gehoren auch Wurste, Trockenfleisch und Eier. Michel arbeitet in Teilzeit als Metallbaumonteur. Er kummert sich um die Aufzucht und den Unterhalt der Tiere, Christa um den Verkauf des Fleischs. «Es geht immer irgendwie», ist das Motto der beiden, die offenbar keinen Aufwand scheuen. Fur das Landfrauenessen entrumpeln sie ihr Wohn- und Kinderspielzimmer komplett und richten es ganz neu ein als schmucken Gasteraum.Christa mochte bei ihrem Menu alles frisch zubereiten, und das erst noch auf die Minute. Mit einer aufgeschaumten Kurbissuppe und Crostini, belegt mit Speck vom Wollschwein, geht es einigermassen entspannt los. Bei den Entenbrusten und selbstgemachten Tagliatelle zum Hauptgang zahlen aber schon fast die Sekunden. Auch das Dessert mit einem Baumnuss-Parfait, einem warmem Himbeer-Coulis und einem Schokoladengeflecht gewahrt keine Verschnaufpause. In der Kuche herrscht viel Hektik und grosse Anspannung. Da ist nur zu hoffen, dass die Landfrauen nichts davon spuren. Schliesslich sollen sie geniessen. Michel, der serviert, lasst sich jedenfalls nichts anmerken.Mit kulinarischen Spezialitaten aus ihrer Region kochen sieben Landfrauen um die Wette. «SRF bi de Lut - Landfrauenkuche» zeigt die Bauerinnen aber nicht nur beim Kochen, sondern begleitet sie auch eine Woche lang durch ihren Alltag und dokumentiert die Vorbereitungen fur den grossen Landfrauenznacht. Im Zentrum steht der Bezug zu den regionaltypischen Spezialitaten und deren Zubereitung in der Kuche. Sieben Mal treten die Landfrauen zum Kochwettbewerb an und beurteilen sich gegenseitig. Auf einer Punkteskala von 1 bis 10 werden der Geschmack und die Prasentation jedes Ganges bewertet. In der Livefinalsendung am Samstag, 5. November 2016, wird die Siegerin erkoren.

programme.title: LImmensità: Meine fantastische Mutter
programme.desc: Rome in the 1970s: Clara (Penelope Cruz) and Felice Borghetti move with their three children to an apartment in a newly built apartment building. However, the latest comfort and the miracle of the miracle of the miracle cannot swap the fact that the family idyll is troubled. Clara and Felice hardly have anything to say and live without love next to each other, he goes back and is violent. But a separation seems impossible, the social rules are too rigid. Clara is boldly lonely in her new home and experiences depressive phases. She escapes into her role as a mother. As a passionate, unconventional woman, she also prints out her feelings through dancing and singing and also likes to give her children imagination and ease so that they can develop. Characteristic with her oldest daughter Adriana has a very intimate relationship. But the 12-year-olds are aware of the growing tensions between her parents, at the same time it begins to be more and more offset as a teenager. When she consciously imagined the neighboring children as a boy named Adri, the fine band, which the family still cohesion, threatens to tear. The Italian director and screenwriter Emanuele Crialese, whose last film "Terraferma" was also seen at SRF, staged a very personal work with "Limmensità". In pictures, some of which are reminiscent of magical realism, broken family structures, loneliness and the search for identity in the middle of a patriarchal and rigid religious rules. Penelope Cruz, who has been interested in cooperation with Crialese for a long time, gives the mother, who is torn between tradition and joie de vivre, full of intense and joy of playing. Luana Giuliani as her daughter, who is found as a boy, is a discovery. "Delicatesses" shows "Limmensità" in two -channel sound in German/Italian. / Rom in den 1970er-Jahren: Clara (Penelope Cruz) und Felice Borghetti ziehen mit ihren drei Kindern in eine Wohnung in einer neu gebauten Mehrfamilienhaussiedlung. Doch der neueste Komfort und der wunderschone Ausblick konnen nicht daruber hinwegtauschen, dass das Familienidyll getrubt ist. Clara und Felice haben sich kaum mehr etwas zu sagen und leben ohne Liebe nebeneinanderher, er hintergeht sie und ist gewalttatig. Doch eine Trennung scheint unmoglich, zu starr sind die gesellschaftlichen Regeln.Clara fuhlt sich haufig einsam in ihrem neuen Heim und durchlebt depressive Phasen. Sie fluchtet sich in ihre Rolle als Mutter. Als leidenschaftliche, unkonventionelle Frau druckt sie ihre Gefuhle auch mal durch Tanzen und Singen aus und mochte auch ihren Kindern Fantasie und Leichtigkeit mitgeben, damit sie sich entfalten konnen.Vor allem zu ihrer altesten Tochter Adriana hat Clara eine sehr innige Beziehung. Doch der 12-Jahrigen sind die wachsenden Spannungen zwischen ihren Eltern bewusst, gleichzeitig beginnt sie sich als Teenager mehr und mehr abzunabeln. Als sie sich den Nachbarskindern bewusst als Junge namens Adri vorstellt, droht das feine Band, das die Familie noch zusammenhalt, zu zerreissen.Der italienische Regisseur und Drehbuchautor Emanuele Crialese, dessen letzter Film «Terraferma» auch bei SRF zu sehen war, hat mit «Limmensità» ein sehr personliches Werk inszeniert. Er erzahlt in Bildern, die teils an den magischen Realismus erinnern, von zerbrochenen Familienstrukturen, Einsamkeit und der Suche nach Identitat inmitten einer patriarchalen und von starren religiosen Regeln gepragten Gesellschaft. Penelope Cruz, die sich schon lange fur eine Zusammenarbeit mit Crialese interessierte, gibt die Mutter, die zwischen Tradition und Lebensfreude zerrissen wird, voller Intensitat und Spielfreude. Luana Giuliani als ihre Tochter, die sich als Junge fuhlt, ist eine Entdeckung.«Delikatessen» zeigt «Limmensità» in Zweikanalton deutsch/italienisch.

programme.title: Survival in the hot time / Überleben in der HeiSSzeit
programme.desc: There have been heat periods often in the history of the earth. But the temperatures on our planet have never risen as quickly as it is today. Palaontologists are finding more and more evidence of the immense effects of the past heat period on life on our planet. Today, scientists are required to correctly interpret the signs from the history of the earth and to look for solutions that ensure the survival of civilization in the new hot period. They try to adapt the city and metropolises to higher temperatures, to protect the coughs in front of the increase in sea levels and to ensure the food of the global affiliation under the conditions of the new hot period. / Schon oft hat es in der Erdgeschichte Hitzeperioden gegeben. Doch noch nie sind die Temperaturen auf unserem Planeten so schnell gestiegen wie heute. Palaontologen finden immer mehr Belege fur die immensen Auswirkungen der vergangenen Hitzeperioden auf das Leben auf unserem Planeten. Heute sind Wissenschaftlerinnen gefordert, die Zeichen aus der Erdgeschichte richtig zu deuten und nach Losungen zu suchen, die das Überleben der Zivilisation in der neuen Heisszeit sichern. Sie versuchen, die Stadte und Metropolen an hohere Temperaturen anzupassen, die Kusten vor dem Meeresspiegelanstieg zu schutzen und die Ernahrung der Weltbevolkerung auch unter den Bedingungen der neuen Heisszeit sicherzustellen.

programme.title: Tagesschau 20 years ago / Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren
programme.desc: The “Tagesschau” of Swiss television has been providing the news look since 1953. The aim is to bring the most important topics at home and abroad every evening. Which domestic debates and international conflicts prompted the reporting at the time - and which of them are still doing it today? Im Laufe der Jahre wurde die Sendung immer wieder angepasst - an die technologischen Entwicklungen, vor allem aber an die Bedurfnisse des Publikums. Gleich geblieben ist der Anspruch, jeden Abend die wichtigsten Themen im In- und Ausland kurz und verstandlich aufzubereiten.Die «Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren» bietet einen Nachrichtenruckblick in die jungere Geschichte: Welche Themen bewegten heute vor exakt 20 Jahren? Welche innenpolitischen Debatten und internationalen Konflikte pragten damals die Berichterstattung - und welche davon tun es bis heute? programme.title: SRF bi de Lut
programme.sub-title: Landfrauenkuche - Sonja Schilt, Iseltwald Be / Landfrauenkuche - Sonja Schilt, Iseltwald BE
programme.desc: The country women travel to the Brienzersee in the Bernese Oberland for the third meal. Sonja Schilt and her family run an organic milk economy here. In summer the stable is empty. Because the 19 cows are on the alp, it can be used for “sleeping in the straw”. This gives a lot to do all summer, generates income and gives Sonja many contacts with all kinds of tourists from all over the world. Her husband Beat is usually with the 27 hectares of land: hay, Emden, everything has to happen in the short warm period when the slopes are sinked enough. In this strict time, the country women come to eat. Sonja has made the Sennentum on her topic and wants to use as much as possible for land women's meals from his own production. The Edelweiss, which keeps up on its alp, runs like a thread through Sonjas Menu. Suffained from a Mutschli, it decorates the alpine soup, which is served for the starter. Edelweiss potato fries accompany the rifle pot with beef. And the dessert, Sonja, mentally calls it a "nightmare", a homemade meringue in Edelweiss shape. Everything is well thought out and planned. Whether it succeeds as the host introduces herself? With culinary specialists from her region, seven country women cook for the bet. "SRF Bi de Lut - Landfrauenkuche" not only shows the farmers when cooking, but also accompanies them for a week through their everyday life and documents the preparations for the big country women's night. The focus is on the reference to the regional specialists and their preparation in the kitchen. The country women compete for the cooking competition seven times and judge each other. On a point scale from 1 to 10, the taste and the prase station of each course are rated. The winner will be chosen in the live finals on Saturday, November 5, 2016. / Fur das dritte Essen reisen die Landfrauen an den Brienzersee im Berner Oberland. Sonja Schilt und ihre Familie betreibt hier einen Bio-Milchwirtschaftsbetrieb. Im Sommer steht der Stall aber leer. Weil die 19 Kuhe auf der Alp sind, kann er fur «Schlafen im Stroh» genutzt werden. Das gibt den ganzen Sommer hindurch viel zu tun, generiert Einnahmen und beschert Sonja viele Kontakte mit allerlei Touristinnen und Touristen aus der ganzen Welt. Ihr Mann Beat ist derweil meist mit den 27 Hektar Land beschaftigt: Heuen, Emden, alles muss in der kurzen warmen Periode passieren, wenn die Hange genug besonnt werden.Ausgerechnet in dieser strengen Zeit kommen die Landfrauen zum Essen. Sonja hat das Sennentum zu ihrem Thema gemacht und will fur das Landfrauenessen so viel wie moglich aus eigener Produktion verwenden. Das Edelweiss, das auf ihrer Alp wachst, zieht sich wie ein roter Faden durch Sonjas Menu. Ausgestochen aus einem Mutschli dekoriert es die Alpkrautersuppe, die zur Vorspeise gereicht wird. Den Sennentopf mit Rindfleisch begleiten Edelweisskartoffel-Frites. Und das Dessert, Sonja nennt es doppeldeutig einen «Alptraum», schmuckt eine hausgemachte Meringue in Edelweissform. Alles ist durchdacht und geplant. Ob es so gelingt, wie die Gastgeberin es sich vorstellt?Mit kulinarischen Spezialitaten aus ihrer Region kochen sieben Landfrauen um die Wette. «SRF bi de Lut - Landfrauenkuche» zeigt die Bauerinnen aber nicht nur beim Kochen, sondern begleitet sie auch eine Woche lang durch ihren Alltag und dokumentiert die Vorbereitungen fur den grossen Landfrauenznacht. Im Zentrum steht der Bezug zu den regionaltypischen Spezialitaten und deren Zubereitung in der Kuche. Sieben Mal treten die Landfrauen zum Kochwettbewerb an und beurteilen sich gegenseitig. Auf einer Punkteskala von 1 bis 10 werden der Geschmack und die Prasentation jedes Ganges bewertet. In der Livefinalsendung am Samstag, 5. November 2016, wird die Siegerin erkoren.

programme.desc: In the fourth episode, the country women travel to the canton of Lucerne to Kulmerau. Rita Kaufmann lives there with her husband Sepp and the three children at the Risihof. Kaufmanns drove a part -time farm farm, which means that Sepp is still working as a consultant for stable institutions. Before and after work, he supplies the Galloway cattle and the mast pigs. Ritas Domane is the herb and bleeding garden. In the middle of the garden there is a small wellness paradise with barefoot path, Kneipp basin and sauna. Rita produces various products for her farm shop from the herbs and bleeding, and Rita cooks the country women with products from the farm. There is a fillet from the Galloway beef for the main course. The noble stucco meat packs Rita in a herb coat. Rita also relies on various herbs and bleeding out of the garden for the starter and dessert, including nettle, girsch and Spitzwegerich. And also as a decoration on the table and in the dining room, their plantings cut a good figure. The country women are not surprised that Rita cooks with herbs and bleeding. However, it will be shown whether you are looking for the intensely tasting ingredients in every course and in every food. Seven country women cook with culinary specialists from their region. "SRF Bi de Lut - Landfrauenkuche" not only shows the farmers while cooking, but also accompanies them for a week through their everyday life and documents the preparations for the big country women. The focus is on the reference to the regional specialists and their preparation in the kitchen. The country women compete for the cooking competition seven times and judge each other. On a point scale from 1 to 10, the taste and the prase station of each course are rated. The winner will be chosen in the live finals on Saturday, November 5, 2016. / In der vierten Folge reisen die Landfrauen in den Kanton Luzern nach Kulmerau. Kaufmanns fuhren einen Nebenerwerbsbauernbetrieb, das bedeutet, dass Sepp noch als Berater fur Stalleinrichtungen arbeitet. Vor und nach der Arbeit versorgt er die Galloway Rinder und die Mastschweine. Ritas Domane ist der Krauter- und Blutengarten. Mitten im Garten gibt es ein kleines Wellness Paradies mit Barfussweg, Kneippbecken und Sauna. Aus den Krautern und Bluten stellt Rita verschiedene Produkte fur ihren Hofladen her.Fur die Landfrauen kocht Rita mit Produkten vom Hof. Zum Hauptgang gibt es ein Filet vom Galloway-Rind. Das edle Stuck Fleisch packt Rita in einen Krautermantel ein. Auch fur die Vorspeise und das Dessert setzt Rita auf verschiedene Krauter und Bluten aus dem Garten, so auch Brennessel, Girsch und Spitzwegerich. Und auch als Dekoration auf dem Tisch und im Essraum machen ihre Pflanzchen eine gute Figur. Die Landfrauen sind nicht uberrascht, dass Rita mit Krautern und Bluten kocht. programme.title: SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: The rural women are on the road for the five times. Your trip goes to the Emmental to Christa Krahenbuhl in Oberhunigen. Together with her husband Bernhard and the five children, she manages the base yard, a company with dairy cows and little agriculture. "Muetti!", It tone about every two to three minutes on the ground if one of the children of Christ needs advice or help, be it in the kitchen or in the evening when the children help in the stable. Christa is a passionate mother and family woman. For the country women, Christa cooks from the farm with products. Christa has furrowed that the rod beans cannot be harvested with the beautiful name “Bernese country women's bean” for the festive day. The wet spring hit them, but it worked: the beans are harvested. To do this, she prepares sliced ​​veal, potato gratin and Ruebli for the main course. For the dessert, Christa extends a yoghurt glace with warm raspberries and a hazelnut crumble. If your competitors expect traditional Bernese courts, you will surely be surprised by Christa's menu election. She loves traditional things, but has decided against the typical Emmental dishes. Whether she can still score with her choice at the country women? With culinary specialists from her region, seven country women cook for the bet. "SRF Bi de Lut - Landfrauenkuche" not only shows the farmers when cooking, but also accompanies them for a week through their everyday life and documents the preparations for the big country women's night. The focus is on the reference to the regional specialists and their preparation in the kitchen. The country women compete for the cooking competition seven times and judge each other. On a point scale from 1 to 10, the taste and the prase station of each course are rated. The winner will be chosen in the live finals on Saturday, November 5, 2016. / Bereits zum funften Mal sind die Landfrauen unterwegs. Ihre Reise geht ins Emmental zu Christa Krahenbuhl nach Oberhunigen. Zusammen mit ihrem Mann Bernhard und den funf Kindern bewirtschaftet sie den Grunderhof, einen Betrieb mit Milchkuhen und wenig Ackerbau. «Muetti!», tont es etwa alle zwei bis drei Minuten auf dem Grunder, wenn eines der Kinder Christas Rat oder Hilfe braucht, sei es in der Kuche oder abends, wenn die Kinder im Stall helfen. Christa ist eine leidenschaftliche Mutter und Familienfrau.Fur die Landfrauen kocht Christa mit Produkten vom Hof. Christa hat befurchtet, dass die Stangenbohnen mit dem schonen Namen «Berner Landfrauenbohne» zum Festtag nicht geerntet werden konnen. Der nasse Fruhling hat ihnen zugesetzt, doch es hat geklappt: Die Bohnen sind erntefrisch. Dazu bereitet sie zum Hauptgang geschnetzeltes Kalbfleisch, Kartoffelgratin und Ruebli zu. Zum Dessert reicht Christa eine Joghurtglace mit warmen Himbeeren und einem Haselnuss-Crumble. Falls ihre Konkurrentinnen traditionelle Berner Gerichte erwarten, werden sie von Christas Menuwahl sicherlich uberrascht sein. Sie liebt Traditionelles, hat sich aber gegen die typischen Emmentaler Gerichte entschieden. Ob sie mit ihrer Wahl bei den Landfrauen trotzdem punkten kann?Mit kulinarischen Spezialitaten aus ihrer Region kochen sieben Landfrauen um die Wette. «SRF bi de Lut - Landfrauenkuche» zeigt die Bauerinnen aber nicht nur beim Kochen, sondern begleitet sie auch eine Woche lang durch ihren Alltag und dokumentiert die Vorbereitungen fur den grossen Landfrauenznacht. Im Zentrum steht der Bezug zu den regionaltypischen Spezialitaten und deren Zubereitung in der Kuche. Sieben Mal treten die Landfrauen zum Kochwettbewerb an und beurteilen sich gegenseitig. Auf einer Punkteskala von 1 bis 10 werden der Geschmack und die Prasentation jedes Ganges bewertet. In der Livefinalsendung am Samstag, 5. November 2016, wird die Siegerin erkoren.

programme.sub-title: Trouble in paradise / Ärger im Paradies
programme.desc: After long considerations, Jasmine makes a decision about her relationship with Gino. Memphis is preparing for a difficult conversation with Hamza. Meanwhile, Usman takes things into his own hands and ensures clarity between him and Kim. Quite different with Bens. His distrust of Mahogany is increasingly strengthening. She wants to know everything about him, but does not keep her past. / Nach langen Überlegungen trifft Jasmine ein fur alle Mal eine Entscheidung uber ihre Beziehung zu Gino. Memphis bereitet sich auf ein schwieriges Gesprach mit Hamza vor. Unterdessen nimmt Usman die Dinge selbst in die Hand und sorgt fur Klarheit zwischen ihm und Kim. Ganz anders bei Bens. Sein Misstrauen gegenuber Mahogany verstarkt sich zusehends. Sie will alles uber ihn wissen, verschweigt aber Ihre Vergangenheit.

programme.title: Dating without limits: in 90 days to the altar / Dating ohne Grenzen: In 90 Tagen zum Altar
programme.desc: The 26-year-old American finds his behavior so impossible that she almost regretted her move to Jordan and preferred to fly home again. She sacrificed her career and many amenities to live on Yazan - and now the Arab behaves like her ex: herral and extremely jealous. / Die 26-jahrige Amerikanerin findet sein Verhalten so unmoglich, dass sie ihren Umzug nach Jordanien fast schon bereut und am liebsten wieder nachhause fliegen wurde. Sie hat ihre Karriere und viele Annehmlichkeiten geopfert, um bei Yazan zu leben - und nun benimmt sich der Araber wie ihr Ex: herrisch und extrem eifersuchtig.

programme.title: Dating without limits: in 90 days to the altar / Dating ohne Grenzen: In 90 Tagen zum Altar
programme.desc: The mood is bad, because Elicia cannot believe how her daughter and grandchildren live: the area looks like the ghetto of Korea, looks uncertain and dangerous. Deavan is also extremely angry with Jihoon. She turns on her whole life for the Korean, and he doesn't even manage to call whether the apartment is suitable for family. / Die Stimmung ist schlecht, denn Elicia kann nicht fassen, wie ihre Tochter und die Enkel wohnen: Die Gegend sieht aus wie das Ghetto von Korea, wirkt unsicher und gefahrlich. Auch Deavan ist extrem wutend auf Jihoon. Sie krempelt ihr ganzes Leben fur den Koreaner um, und er schafft es nicht einmal zu prufen, ob die Wohnung familientauglich ist.

programme.title: In 90 days to the altar: forever and forever? / In 90 Tagen zum Altar: Auf immer und ewig?
programme.sub-title: Home Sweet Home / Trautes Heim, Gluck allein
programme.desc: After six months, Nicole finally sees her husband Mahmoud in the USA. The 40-year-old from Los Angeles is oversleeping and formally fell on him, but the Egyptian is dog mude after the long flight. In addition, as a Muslim, he does not want any gvalities in public and finds it inappropriate that Nicole runs stomach -free. During the first tour in the new home, the 31-year-old pulls a face, and Nicole furrows that he will never be comfortable in America. In addition: Ed and Liz dare to start a new beginning and Manuel's secrecy makes Ashley suspicious. / Nach sechs Monaten sieht Nicole ihren Mann Mahmoud endlich in den USA wieder. Die 40-Jahrige aus Los Angeles ist uberglucklich und sturzt sich formlich auf ihn, doch der Ägypter ist hundemude nach dem langen Flug. Ausserdem will er als Muslim keine Zartlichkeiten in der Öffentlichkeit und findet es unangebracht, dass Nicole bauchfrei herumlauft. Schon wahrend der ersten Rundfahrt in der neuen Heimat zieht der 31-Jahrige ein Gesicht, und Nicole befurchtet, dass er sich in Amerika womoglich nie wohlfuhlen wird. AuSSerdem: Ed und Liz wagen einen Neuanfang und Manuels Geheimniskramerei macht Ashley misstrauisch.

programme.title: In 90 days to the altar: forever and forever? / In 90 Tagen zum Altar: Auf immer und ewig?
programme.desc: After years of long-distance relationships, Sumit and Jenny have married and now live together in Neu-Delhi. The way there was rocky because the Indian had hidden that a marriage had already been arranged for him. And so his parents are not very enthusiastic about the 63-year-old American, who could be slightly Sumit's mother. Bilal from Missouri and Shaeeda from Trinidad have said yes, although there were great difficulties in advance about the marriage contract and Bilal. And Kim wants to share her life with a young Nigerian rapper, and even accept a second woman. / Nach jahrelanger Fernbeziehung haben Sumit und Jenny geheiratet und leben nun zusammen in Neu-Delhi. Der Weg dorthin war steinig, denn der Inder hatte verheimlicht, dass fur ihn bereits eine Ehe arrangiert war. Und so sind seine Eltern wenig begeistert von der 63-jahrigen Amerikanerin, die leicht Sumits Mutter sein konnte. Bilal aus Missouri und Shaeeda aus Trinidad haben sich das Ja-Wort gegeben, obwohl es im Vorfeld grosse Schwierigkeiten wegen des Ehevertrags und Bilals Ex-Frau gab. Und Kim will ihr Leben mit einem jungen nigerianischen Rapper teilen, und dafur sogar eine Zweitfrau akzeptieren.

programme.title: In 90 days to the altar: Countdown for love / In 90 Tagen zum Altar: Countdown fur die Liebe
programme.desc: The relationship between Kim and Usman is put to the test. Likewise Gino: He tries to win Jasmine's mother by all means. Mike and Ximenas cattle with communication problems.
